flags: PHONE DIFFERS: stored 740-453-4377 appears nowhere on the ODNR pages, which list (740) 558-6040 (shared with Jesse Owens, which manages it). Reservations (866) 644-6727.

NAME: ODNR and ReserveOhio call it 'Muskingum River State Park' and the facility 'Ellis Lock #11 Campground'; the stored name says 'Muskingum River Parkway State Park (Ellis Lock 11)'. The website's URL already uses muskingum-river-state-park.

WATERFRONT riverfront CONFIRMED on imagery: an open grass field on the Muskingum River just above the dam. Front-row sites 1-6 plot about 15-30 m from the bank with nothing between; rear sites 8-12 about 60-100 m. Pads are unmarked grass, but the plotted coordinates sit in the visible mown area.

SEASON vs ENGINE: ODNR closes the camp Nov 1-Mar 31, but ReserveOhio showed all 19 sites free on 2026-11-01, 2026-11-17, 2027-01-19 and 2027-03-16 at the $19 off-peak rate. I wrote ODNR's dates. Worth a call before any winter booking.

PIN OK: stored 40.0442,-81.9781 is 89 m from the centroid (40.0442,-81.9771). No split: Luke Chute is a separate 8-site area ODNR describes, with lock-area camping for 'boaters in transit'; the stored note calls it boat-in, and the page neither confirms nor contradicts that.
